title: One cube, cumulative motion
short: Cube rises → add turn → add pulse → collect by walking. Teach whole-object transforms; time supports motion; overlap supports collection. Keep geometry fixed.
bring: Cube shape and creation, coordinates, initialization and updates.
given: Existing Endless Museum room, camera, light and player; desktop em_walker/layer 1 or XR player_body/layer 20. Collision and riding in installed artifacts only, except the explicitly created overlap areas.
build: One box; elapsed wave; three transform assignments; area and player-filtered signal.
check: Disable operations independently; stretch the wave period; collect through actual overlap.
later: Score, flourish, a general interaction framework.

title: Three ways to reach
short: Reuse translate/rotate/scale in three models of the installed crossings. Hold poses; animate; move the far bank and inspect the gap.
bring: Pre’s cube and transforms; functions and loops from Primitives.
given: Existing Endless Museum room, camera, light and player; desktop em_walker/layer 1 or XR player_body/layer 20. Collision and riding in installed artifacts only, except the explicitly created overlap areas.
build: Repeat known construction with a returning box function; interpolate a pose fraction.
check: At full pose, compare bank edges; move the far bank half a metre without changing the span.
later: Rider transport, physical support and detailed control wiring.

title: Position, then route
short: Move a level box diagonally. Compare a rise-then-across journey to the same destination. Keep orientation and size.
bring: Travel study; displacement from Lines; time and interpolation.
given: Existing Endless Museum room, camera, light and player; desktop em_walker/layer 1 or XR player_body/layer 20. Collision and riding in installed artifacts only, except the explicitly created overlap areas.
build: Two endpoints; direct interpolation; one optional corner and a branch.
check: Predict halfway and final positions for both paths; add Z to the destination.
later: General waypoint machines, curved paths and constant-speed reparameterization.

title: A chosen centre
short: Turn the box through a parent pivot. Mark a face; offset the box; change the axis. Separate local position from world movement.
bring: Cube, time, local/world coordinates; hierarchy already encountered.
given: Existing Endless Museum room, camera, light and player; desktop em_walker/layer 1 or XR player_body/layer 20. Collision and riding in installed artifacts only, except the explicitly created overlap areas.
build: Pivot node; fixed child offset; axis-angle orientation; attached mark.
check: Quarter-turn centre and face position; fixed internal distances; full return; another axis.
later: Multiple rotation order, rider orientation and sweep rendering.

title: A group changes size
short: Three boxes make a doorway; a black point remains outside its parent. Compare uniform enlargement and width-only change.
bring: Parent-child relation; box function; familiar sphere construction.
given: Existing Endless Museum room, camera, light and player; desktop em_walker/layer 1 or XR player_body/layer 20. Collision and riding in installed artifacts only, except the explicitly created overlap areas.
build: One scaled parent; known meshes placed around a threshold origin.
check: Predict clear dimensions and unchanged witness under 4×, width-only and 2× XY changes.
later: Room relocation, solid passage and material theory.

title: Approach supplies the value
short: World-space horizontal distance drives one cube’s bounded scale or turn. Preserve its floor contact; departure restores it.
bring: Scale, turn, vectors, conditions and the museum player contract.
given: Existing Endless Museum room, camera, light and player; desktop em_walker/layer 1 or XR player_body/layer 20. Collision and riding in installed artifacts only, except the explicitly created overlap areas.
build: Declared player group lookup; range mapping; response function.
check: Near/middle/far values; height independence; return; extend the sensing reach.
later: Multi-visitor blending, smoothing and cell removal.

title: Compose an opening
short: Two boxes translate, turn and shrink beside a fixed frame. Actual player overlap requests opening; absence requests return.
bring: All three transforms; construction function; array, loop and Area3D.
given: Existing Endless Museum room, camera, light and player; desktop em_walker/layer 1 or XR player_body/layer 20. Collision and riding in installed artifacts only, except the explicitly created overlap areas.
build: Two leaves; one bounded progress value; continuing occupancy query.
check: Closed/middle/open poses; slower duration; greater slide; props ignored; either visitor holds it open.
later: Solid leaf collision, staged movement and the installed closing delay.
